_note: Story script + shot list. img = assets/story/clay/.jpg, vo = audio/vo/.mp3 (missing files must be tolerated: fall back to showing the caption for a few seconds). who is the speaker label shown on the subtitle. Captions are subtitles of the spoken line only. call = Sal's goal line, phoned in as the chapter starts (pic/crop = the polaroid: assets/story/clay/.jpg cropped by background-position x%, y% and background-size %). calls = clear (goal met), nudge (wandering away from the district), hey (walking up to Sal at the shop; followed by the chapter's call). day = the weekday on the chapter card (one chapter per day, Monday to Friday). mission = the big paper mission card [headline, second line]. why = an extra phone line after the goal call. Shot extras (no re-encode): flip:true mirrors the still and the clip; vid 'name#t=a,b' plays only a..b of the clip (a media fragment; the shot ends at b); mute:true silences the clip's own track; over = a vo line laid over the clip (a line over someone's back).

in.cap: Duuude. That's like… a lot of vapes.
Fifty! I said FIFTY! Five, zero! Not five THOUSAND! …Hello? HELLO?!
Kid! Oh, thank God you're here. I gotta sell all of these by Friday… or I'm closing the shop.
So get out there. Get this town HOOKED!
Say less, boss. I got you.

call.cap: Kid! Start right here, downtown. Hook me five customers and bring 'em back to the shop. Go!

out.cap: They're… coming back? They're coming BACK!

why.cap: And kid? The invoice is due FRIDAY, or the bank takes Cloud Kingz. This town won Cleanest Air in Florida, 1994. Nobody here's ever SEEN a vape!

chapters.title: Word of Mouth
mission: THEN WALK 5 GRANDMAS TO CLOUD KINGZ

in.cap: Park's full of grandmas, man. Grandmas love me.

call.cap: The park, kid! Grandmas run this town: one grandma tells forty. But nobody walks out on the opera lady mid-song. Get her on our side, then walk me five!

out.cap: Kid! I sold out of mango! I've never sold out of ANYTHING!

chapters.title: Home Turf
mission: THEN WALK 5 BROS TO CLOUD KINGZ

in.cap: Watch out for cops. And the big guy at the gym.

call.cap: Beach, kid! Nobody on Muscle Beach breathes till Prime breathes first. Out-lung the big guy and his boys'll follow you anywhere. Five, back to the shop!

out.cap: Two chains, kid. TWO. We're franchising.

in.cap: We're out of people, kid. …What about the cows?

call.cap: Thursday, kid. Two thousand left and nobody left in town. …The farm. Five. Yeah. Cows count.

out.cap: Can't even see the waves anymore, man.

call.cap: Invoice is due at SUNDOWN, kid! Empty the container! And somebody shut up that smoke detector!

end.cap: Zero. You did it, kid… So, uh. I ordered fifty thousand.

clear.cap: That's the district, kid! Look at 'em all! LOOK at 'em!

nudge.cap: Kid, the other way! Follow the cloud!

hey.cap: Hey! Kid! You lost? Here's the deal.

back1.cap: Kid! Bring 'em back to the shop! Bring 'em HERE!

back2.cap: You got customers? Walk 'em over, kid! Cloud Kingz! I'm right here!

back3.cap: Kid, kid, kid! Don't leave 'em out there! Bring 'em to the store!

enough.cap: That's enough, kid! That's the whole order! Bring 'em home, I'm holding the door!

live._note: Sal's live reactions at the Cloud Kingz door as delivered customers walk in (audio only, no caption on screen). count[k-1] is said for the chapter's k-th delivery; alright opens a fresh batch.

districts._note: Game-world coordinates (x, z). Ocean is at -z (east on the map). See assets/clay/map_town.png and docs/story-bible.md.

shop._note: proposed vape shop block, replaces the downtown building at grid (0, +1)

lines._note: Short voice lines the bosses say in play (audio/vo/<key>.mp3); the caption shows under the crosshair while it plays.

diva_won.cap: Bravissima! BRAVISSIMA! Darling… does it come in MANGO?

diva_again.cap: Ah-ah-ah, darling. Not yet. Wait for the top of the phrase!

prime_intro.cap: Nobody breathes on my beach till PRIME breathes first. Lung set, bro. Three reps. Match me.

prime_won.cap: …Respect, king. RESPECT. Take the chain. Boys? We follow him now.

detecto_intro.cap: SMOKE DETECTED. I am DETECTO, official mascot of Cleanest Air in Florida, 1994. Everybody: EVACUATE.

detecto_sleep.cap: Sensor… full. Low… battery. Beep. Beep… goodnight.
